source_title: ‘Zero Tolerance Day’ against traffic violations to be observed by Chennai Traffic Police on October 31

The Greater Chennai Traffic Police (GCTP) will conduct a special enforcement drive across the city on Saturday (October 31) as part of its ‘Zero Tolerance Day’ initiative against traffic violations.
The drive will cover all major and arterial roads in Chennai, with cases to be registered against motorists found violating traffic rules. The initiative aims to ensure strict compliance with traffic regulations and improve road safety.
The GCTP has appealed to motorists to obey traffic signals, wear helmets and seat belts, avoid speeding and dangerous driving, and refrain from using mobile phones while driving.
Emphasising the importance of protecting human lives and preventing road accidents, the traffic police have urged the public to cooperate with the enforcement drive and adhere to traffic rules to ensure safer roads for all.
